proposal: Compute elapsed fraction of the quarter and show 'On pace' / 'Behind: need AED X per week to keep the bonus (50%)' and 'AED Y per week to hit target', tone by pace not raw %. Reuse the same helper in TeamMonitor's target column so the owner sees who is about to forfeit.
benefit: Agents act in week 6, not week 12; the owner can intervene before a slab downgrade, which is exactly what the fäm-style rule is meant to drive.

title: Deal documents: Form F/MOU, NOC, SPA, deposit are checkboxes with no file
what: A deal's paperwork exists only as dated checkboxes: DEAL_MILESTONES at lib/crm.ts:557-563 (form_b, form_f "Form F / MOU signed", noc_applied, noc_received) rendered as a checklist in components/crm/Deals.tsx:343-350. No deal field holds a file (CrmDeal at lib/crm.ts:180-205 has no documents/url field). The storage layer cannot even address one: PATH_RE at lib/crm-files.ts:24 only allows avatars/<userId>/ and docs/<userId>/, FileKind at lib/crm-files.ts:14 is only avatar | doc, and the only document table is per-agent (agent_documents, owner user_id, app/api/crm/data/[table]/route.ts:203-213). So the signed MOU, the deposit cheque photo and the developer NOC stay on the agent's phone/WhatsApp, and the owner cannot prove a deal closed from the CRM.
proposal: Add a third FileKind "deal" with path deals/<dealId>/<random>.<ext> in lib/crm-files.ts and app/api/crm/upload/route.ts, and show a "Documents" list inside the deal side panel (Deals.tsx, next to the checklist) where ticking a milestone such as Form F or NOC received offers to attach the file; the same list drives an "Open" link per milestone.
benefit: The agent closes the deal from one screen with the signed Form F, deposit proof and NOC attached; the owner can audit any deal without asking the agent for WhatsApp screenshots.

title: Tenancy contract and Ejari certificate cannot be attached to a tenancy
what: Rentals track Ejari as a number only: input at components/crm/Rentals.tsx:222, 'Missing' pill at Rentals.tsx:125, red warning at Rentals.tsx:229 ("Register the contract on Ejari"). CrmTenancy (lib/crm.ts:620-628) has ejari_no / ejari_expiry and a cheques array but no contract or certificate file. The upload stack (uploadFile at components/crm/shared.tsx:310, /api/crm/upload) is used only by AgentDocuments.tsx:23 and avatars. A renewal 11 months later means hunting for the signed contract outside the CRM.
proposal: Reuse the "deal"-style path (or deals/<tenancyId>/) and add two attach slots to the tenancy form in Rentals.tsx: signed tenancy contract and Ejari certificate, with the Ejari 'Missing' pill turning green only when the certificate file is attached (not merely a typed number).
benefit: Renewal and DEWA/RDC disputes are handled from the CRM; the owner stops accepting a typed Ejari number as proof.

title: KYC asks for a pasted link to the ID copy instead of an upload
what: components/crm/Kyc.tsx:89-90 renders id_doc_url and passport_doc_url as free-text fields labelled "Link to ID copy" / "Link to passport copy", and "Open ID copy" at Kyc.tsx:135-136 just follows whatever URL was typed. kycMissing at lib/crm.ts:538 blocks the file as incomplete until one of those is set. An agent on a phone who has just photographed the client's Emirates ID has nowhere to put it: the only real upload UI is AgentDocuments.tsx:19-28, which files it under the agent's own IDs (kind "id") and would mislabel the client's passport as the agent's.
proposal: Replace the two text inputs with the same dashed file picker used at AgentDocuments.tsx:42-46, calling uploadFile(file, ...) and writing the returned /api/crm/file URL into id_doc_url / passport_doc_url; keep the field accepting a pasted link as a fallback.
benefit: KYC can actually be completed on-site from a phone; the owner's compliance view stops showing files 'complete' on the strength of an arbitrary Google Drive link.

title: Uploading a visa or ID never records its expiry
what: The upload form at components/crm/AgentDocuments.tsx:39-49 captures only kind and title; CrmAgentDocument (lib/crm.ts:435-442) has no expiry. The expiries that drive licenceAlerts (lib/crm.ts:455-466), MyDay (MyDay.tsx:51), Team.tsx:117-123 and Compliance.tsx:97 live in separate profile fields brn_expiry / visa_expiry / emirates_id_expiry (lib/crm.ts:48-50) that only the admin edits in Team.tsx:123. TeamDocuments (TeamMonitor.tsx:240) shows Document / Type / Team member / Added and no expiry, so the admin sees a visa was uploaded but not that it ran out last month.
proposal: When kind is visa, id or license, show an 'Expires on' date in the upload form and, on save, PATCH the agent's own visa_expiry / emirates_id_expiry / brn_expiry (existing columns, via the users table the profile already updates); add an 'Expires' column to TeamDocuments read from those fields, coloured by licenceAlerts.
benefit: Expiry alerts fill themselves in from the document the agent just uploaded; the owner no longer has to type dates off a scan.

title: Admin can only view team documents, not add or remove them
what: TeamDocuments (components/crm/TeamMonitor.tsx:215-270) is read-only: the only action is 'Open' (TeamMonitor.tsx:256-260) and the caption at TeamMonitor.tsx:233 says 'Agents add documents from My profile.' Yet the backend already supports admin filing: /api/crm/upload accepts user_id for admins (app/api/crm/upload/route.ts:31-33), uploadFile takes a userId (components/crm/shared.tsx:310,317) that no caller passes, agent_documents has adminFields user_id (app/api/crm/data/[table]/route.ts:212), and allowed() lets admins delete any row (route.ts:227-229). The owner who receives a new hire's passport on WhatsApp must forward it and ask them to upload it.
proposal: Add an 'Upload for <agent>' button to TeamDocuments that reuses AgentDocuments' form with the selected team member as userId, plus a delete icon per row for the admin.
benefit: Onboarding paperwork is filed by the owner in one step; wrong or duplicate uploads can be cleaned up without touching the database.

title: Agents can permanently delete their own compliance documents
what: components/crm/AgentDocuments.tsx:63 shows a Trash button on every row for the signed-in agent, guarded only by window.confirm. The DELETE handler lets an owner delete their row (allowed(), app/api/crm/data/[table]/route.ts:229-232) and then removes the file from storage (route.ts:409-414). An agent who is leaving, or who uploaded a wrong document, can wipe the ID/visa/contract the owner relies on, with no copy and no audit entry specific to documents.
proposal: Hide the delete control for non-admins in AgentDocuments (render it only when the caller is admin) and have the API refuse non-admin DELETE on agent_documents; agents who uploaded the wrong file simply upload the right one and the admin removes the old.
benefit: The owner's record of who held which visa/licence cannot be erased by the agent it concerns.

title: iPhone HEIC uploads cannot be opened on the laptop
what: image/heic is accepted (lib/crm-files.ts:20, accept list at components/crm/AgentDocuments.tsx:45) and served back unchanged with Content-Type image/heic and Content-Disposition inline (app/api/crm/file/route.ts:22-29). Chrome/Edge on Windows do not render HEIC, so the admin clicking 'Open' in TeamDocuments (TeamMonitor.tsx:257) gets a download or a blank tab for every photo an agent took with an iPhone. Because image/heic is listed in accept, iOS sends the original HEIC instead of auto-converting to JPEG as it does when only JPEG/PNG are accepted. shrinkImage (shared.tsx:330) is applied to avatars only (AgentProfile.tsx:37), never to documents.
proposal: Drop image/heic from the accept attribute and FILE_TYPES so iOS converts to JPEG on pick, and run image documents through shrinkImage(file, 2000) before uploadFile in AgentDocuments.tsx:23 (keeps passports legible, cuts most photos under the 5 MB cap at lib/crm-files.ts:12).
benefit: Every document opens in the browser on both phone and laptop, and the 'over 5 MB, compress it' error (shared.tsx:323) mostly disappears for phone photos.

title: Documents suite is a sealed page: admin-only, nothing prefilled from the CRM
what: /documents serves private/documents/suite.html, an encrypted self-contained HTML (lib/documents-suite.ts:17-52) whose own landing copy promises 'Tenancy, listing, handover and payment documents, filled once and ready to sign' (suite.html aside). It is reachable only by the admin (app/documents/route.ts:28, app/api/crm/login/route.ts:162-164 returns admin_only for agents), opens in a new tab from the sidebar (components/crm/CrmApp.tsx:323-327), and has no link to CRM data: the route returns static html with no deal, contact or listing injected (route.ts:34-35). So an agent cannot produce an offer, tenancy document or receipt at all, and the owner retypes the client name, unit and price that already sit in CrmDeal/CrmContact/CrmListing. Its session is also 4 h (lib/crm-auth.ts:118) against the CRM's 10 h (crm-auth.ts:17), so the owner re-enters the password mid-afternoon.
proposal: Expose the generators inside the CRM: a 'Documents' action on a deal / tenancy / listing panel that opens the suite with the record's fields prefilled (pass a signed, short-lived token plus deal id in the hash, the route already carries #LP-… across sign-in per route.ts:23-24), and allow agents to generate but not edit templates. At minimum align DOCS_MS with SESSION_MS.
benefit: Agents produce a tenancy contract or offer letter from the deal they are on, with no retyping; the owner stops being the bottleneck for every piece of paper.

title: No deposit or cheque receipt for the client, only an accountant's tax invoice
what: The only printable money document is the tax invoice: 'Create tax invoice' at components/crm/Deals.tsx:420 and printInvoice at components/crm/Invoices.tsx:260-278, addressed to the paying party for the commission. Deposit collection is a milestone checkbox (lib/crm.ts:278 'collect the deposit', DEAL_MILESTONES at crm.ts:557-563) and rent cheques are rows with no, bank, date, amount, status at Rentals.tsx:190-253. Nothing produces the receipt a buyer or tenant is handed when they pay a 10% deposit or a cheque, so agents write one in Word or the admin uses the sealed suite.
proposal: Add a 'Receipt' button on the deal deposit milestone and on each cheque row in Rentals that opens the same window.open print pattern as printInvoice, prefilled with the brokerage header already used by the invoice, the payer (contact), amount, method and unit, and stores the printed receipt number back on the milestone / cheque.
benefit: The client gets a numbered receipt on the spot from the agent's phone, and every AED received is traceable to a deal or tenancy.

title: Document kinds miss what RERA and HR actually ask for
what: DOC_KINDS at lib/crm.ts:430-433 is id, visa, license, contract, other. The profile and compliance code already distinguish BRN card, Emirates ID, passport, visa and RERA exam certificate (lib/crm.ts:48-51, Team.tsx:123 'RERA exam passed') yet uploads collapse Emirates ID and passport into one 'ID / passport' and have no slot for the RERA certificate, labour card or the signed commission agreement, so TeamDocuments' type filter (TeamMonitor.tsx:229-232) cannot answer 'who has not given me a passport copy' and most files end up as 'other'.
proposal: Split DOC_KINDS into passport, emirates_id, visa, brn_card, rera_certificate, employment_contract, commission_agreement, other (labels in DOC_KIND_LABEL), and show a per-agent 'missing' strip in TeamDocuments listing which required kinds have no upload, in the same style as kycMissing.
benefit: The owner sees at a glance which agent still owes which document before a RERA inspection, instead of opening files one by one.

title: Reveal then Add-as-lead charges the agent two reveals
what: On a result card the add-to-CRM buttons only exist inside the revealed-numbers block (DsCardView.tsx:141-163), so every lead/contact created from a card has already cost one reveal. The add action then draws on the reveals quota again (route.ts:289 `quota(user, db, as === "temp" ? "lists" : "reveals")`), and usageToday counts to_lead/to_contact as reveals (guard.ts:227). The burst lock counts the same pair (guard.ts:236: reveal+to_lead+to_contact, max 15 in 10 min), so 8 owners revealed and saved in 10 minutes locks the agent out until the admin unlocks (guard.ts:245). The lock is applied after the reveal is already written (route.ts:190-191) and the agent gets no warning before it; the header only shows searches used, never reveals (DbSearch.tsx:169).
proposal: When the add follows a reveal of the same ref in this session (the card already holds the number), count it as a CRM action, not a second reveal; keep the double count only for the owner-panel path where add is the reveal. Show `reveals used/limit` next to searches in the header and a soft warning at 10 reveals in 10 minutes instead of a silent lock.
benefit: Agents stop running out of reveals (default 40/day) halfway through a calling session and stop getting locked for normal work.

title: Two different reveal dialogs; reason re-picked on every card
what: Cards reveal with an inline chip picker that fetches every number at once (DsCardView.tsx:54-67, 171; route.ts:179-182 kind "phones"). The owner panel instead opens a modal with a <select>, a Choose-a-reason placeholder and a confirm button (DsOwnerPanel.tsx:160-212), and reveals one number per call (DsOwnerPanel.tsx:174 index, route.ts:182) so a 3-number owner costs three reveals and three dialogs. REASONS is declared three times (api.ts:103, DsOwnerPanel.tsx:9, route.ts:45). Nothing remembers the reason: an agent doing owner outreach picks "Selling: owner outreach" on all 50 cards of a tower.
proposal: Use the card's ReasonPicker in the owner panel and reveal all numbers at once there too. Remember the last reason for the session and make the button one tap: "Show 2 numbers · Selling: owner outreach (change)"; the reason still goes to the audit row.
benefit: One tap from card to number instead of three, same behaviour everywhere, same audit trail.

title: Switching tab throws the results away and re-searching costs quota
what: DbSearch renders `<main key={tab}>` and mounts one tab component at a time (DbSearch.tsx:210-216); every tab keeps its query and results in local state (DsSearch.tsx:45-47, DsPhone.tsx:26-28, DsBrokers.tsx:20-22). Search → Phone → back to Search shows the empty Top-areas screen; the Smart tab mounts its own DsSearch instance (DsSmart.tsx:180), so a Smart question and the Search tab never share results. Every re-run is audited and counted before the result is fetched (route.ts:131-133), including zero-result ones.
proposal: Lift each tab's last query + result into DbSearch (or keep the four tab trees mounted and hidden) so coming back shows what was there; let Smart hand its result to the Search tab instead of mounting a second DsSearch.
benefit: An agent can check a number on Phone and come back to the tower list without paying another search or re-scrolling 300 cards.

title: Idle timeout wipes the results the agent was calling from
what: When any call returns ds_signin_required, onExpired flips signedIn and DbSearch returns <DsSignIn> in place of the whole tree (DbSearch.tsx:96, 146, 149), unmounting DsSearch and its results. The idle limit is 20 minutes (guard.ts:25), shorter than one real owner call; re-entry needs password plus an emailed code (DsSignIn.tsx:93, 130). After sign-in the agent must re-run the search (another audited search, route.ts:133) even though the refs on the old cards are valid for two hours (guard.ts:26).
proposal: Keep the DB Search tree mounted and show the sign-in as an overlay; once signed in, the previous results and revealed numbers are still on screen. Refresh the idle timer on scroll/click activity (a ping) so a 25-minute call does not end the session.
benefit: No lost list, no second search, no re-typed code mid-session.

title: Search cards cannot open the owner panel
what: CardActions has no onOpenOwner (DsCardView.tsx:15-19); the panel is reachable only from the Area table, Property checks and Unit history (DsArea.tsx:104, DsChecks.tsx:93, DsUnit.tsx:107). So from a Search or Phone result the agent never sees what the panel gives: current-owner status from unit_current_owner (search.ts:20-65), the owner's other properties linked by the same phone (search.ts:114-125) and the unit History button (DsOwnerPanel.tsx:132). The only sold signal on a card is the Damac Lagoons flag (DsResultsList.tsx:83). The `owner` action is not counted as a search (route.ts:151-158).
proposal: Add an "Owner" link on every card (next to the badges) that calls onOpenOwner(card.ref); the card ref already carries the owner ids the `owner` action needs.
benefit: Before dialling, the agent sees "Sold since 2023" or "also owns 3 units in JVC" instead of calling a previous owner.

title: WhatsApp opens blank; no Copy for a revealed number
what: Every WhatsApp link is a bare phone link with no text: DsCardView.tsx:151 (`api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=`), DsOwnerPanel.tsx:98, DsPhone.tsx:68, DsBrokers.tsx:71 (`wa.me/`). The agent types the same opener each time on a phone keyboard. The card knows the unit, building and community (DsCardView.tsx:132-134, m.badge) and the session knows the agent's name (route.ts:66). On a laptop `tel:` does nothing useful (DsCardView.tsx:150) and the only Copy button is for the email (DsCardView.tsx:233-235); the owner panel has no copy at all (DsOwnerPanel.tsx:92-99).
proposal: Prefill the WhatsApp link with `&text=` ("Hello, this is {agent} from Lababidi Properties about your {unit} in {building}…", editable template in settings) and add a Copy button beside each revealed number in the card and the panel.
benefit: Search → reveal → message in one tap; on desktop the number goes straight to the dialer app or CRM note.

title: Phone tab asks the agent to reveal the number they just typed
what: phoneList returns the matching owners as masked cards with a phoneCount (results.ts:378-399), DsPhone passes them to DsResultsList (DsPhone.tsx:88-90) and each card shows the same "Show N numbers" button that needs a reason and a reveal (DsCardView.tsx:169-174). To get Call/WhatsApp for a number the agent already has (a missed call, a WhatsApp enquiry) they spend a reveal and a reason on their own input. Only the broker summary shows a direct WhatsApp link (DsPhone.tsx:68).
proposal: On the Phone tab, show Call / WhatsApp / Add-to-CRM for the searched number on every card without a reveal (the server can return `queried: true` for that index), and keep the reveal only for the record's other numbers.
benefit: Answering "who is this calling me" takes one lookup, no reveal spent, and the lead can be saved immediately.

title: "show them" (records with no phone) re-runs the whole search
what: The hiddenEmpty line's "show them" calls load({...mode, includeEmpty:true}) (DsSearch.tsx:167), which is a second POST /search that is audited and counted as a new search (route.ts:131-139) and re-runs smart_search, list_communities, search_damac_transactions and search_place_broad (results.ts:319-324). The server already had every row: `before - kept` is computed in the same pass (results.ts:335-337, 354).
proposal: Return the empty rows as a third view (or flag them in `loose`) on the first response and let "show them" toggle client-side like "show anyway" does (DsResultsList.tsx:41, 49).
benefit: One less search per lookup from the quota and a 1-3 s wait removed.

title: Top-area chips run a text search, not the community list
what: The twelve Top-areas chips call run(undefined, full) (DsSearch.tsx:213), i.e. the free-text `search` path (results.ts:317) that goes through smart_search, whereas the "what we found" chips use the `community` path, which lists every record of the community (DsSearch.tsx:144, results.ts:360). Smart's "Everything in {area}" alternative does the same (DsSmart.tsx:80, 91: kind "search", q: area). The text path is the one known to drop records and to duplicate on community-label case (see smart_search memory notes); the community path returns the full set.
proposal: Make the Top-areas chips and Smart's "Everything in X" call load({kind:"community", name}) so an area tap lists the area, and keep free text for names and codes.
benefit: "Damac Hills 2" returns the whole community once, not a partial text match.

title: Adding a lead from a card jumps the agent out of the list
what: After a successful "Lead" on a card, DsCardView calls actions.onOpenLead(id) (DsCardView.tsx:102), which window.open()s the CRM tab on the pipeline (DbSearchApp.tsx:57) and pulls focus away from the DB Search list the agent is working down. The owner panel does the opposite: it prints "Lead created and assigned to you." with no way to open it (DsOwnerPanel.tsx:45). "Contact" and "Temp lead" never open anything. The card's inline confirmation already exists for the other two kinds (DsCardView.tsx:101, 153).
proposal: Never auto-navigate: show "Added as a lead · Open" inline (card and panel alike), and open the CRM tab only when the agent taps Open.
benefit: An agent working a tower list of 60 owners stays on the list; the lead is one tap away when wanted.

title: DB Search bottom tab opens a new browser tab on phones
what: CrmApp.tsx:477 — the DB Search bottom-tab button calls window.open(dbSearchHref, "lababidi-db-search"). On a phone this spawns a second browser tab every time; the agent then has two tabs (CRM and DB Search) and the CRM's own bottom nav is gone in the DB Search tab. DbSearch.tsx:108-117 'Back to CRM' then has to hunt for the named window via window.open("", "lababidi-crm"), which mobile Safari/Chrome do not reliably honour, so it falls back to a full navigation (line 110). The same pattern repeats at CrmApp.tsx:296 (sidebar, target="lababidi-db-search") and CrmApp.tsx:397 ('Open DB Search' card). The 'opens in its own tab' rationale (CrmApp.tsx:395-396: separate sign-in code) is a desktop reason; on a phone an agent just wants to look up an owner and come back.
proposal: On viewports under md, navigate in place (window.location.href = dbSearchHref) instead of window.open, and make DbSearch's 'Back to CRM' a plain history.back()/location change on phones. Keep the named-window behaviour for md and up.
benefit: Agents on a phone stop collecting stray tabs and losing the CRM bottom nav when they jump into DB Search; one tap in, one tap back.

title: Bottom tabs: swap DB Search slot for People or Tasks
what: CrmApp.tsx:473 hard-codes the bottom tabs as home, leads, calendar, dbsearch + More. Contacts (People), Deals, Listings, Tasks and Tools/WhatsApp are all behind More → Everything sheet (CrmApp.tsx:490-513): two taps and a scroll. Meanwhile the dbsearch slot leaves the app entirely (see point 1). The badge logic at CrmApp.tsx:480 also only shows red badges; the calendar section's badgeTone 'plain' (line 180) is ignored on mobile, so a due-task count looks like an alarm.
proposal: Make the four fixed slots Home, Leads, People, Calendar and keep DB Search as the first row inside the Everything sheet (or as a header icon). Honour badgeTone in the mobile badge so task counts render in the accent colour, not red.
benefit: The screens an agent opens between viewings (who is this contact, what's due) are one tap, and red badges mean something.

title: Contacts, Deals, Rentals tables scroll sideways on phones
what: globals.css:969-972 forces white-space:nowrap on every table cell under 768px, and the tables are wrapped in Card overflow-x-auto (Contacts.tsx:81-102 with 8 columns, Deals.tsx:110-142 with 9 columns, Rentals.tsx:106, TempLeads.tsx:49, OwnerRequests.tsx:60, Invoices.tsx:142, AgentRequests.tsx:76, Audit.tsx:17). On a 390px screen the agent sees Name and Type, then must drag horizontally to reach Phone (Contacts col 5) or Status (Deals col 9). Rows are tap-to-open (Contacts.tsx:90, Deals.tsx:121) but there is no phone or WhatsApp action in the row itself. Pipeline already solved this with a stacked card list for sm:hidden (Pipeline.tsx:110-157); the other tables did not follow.
proposal: For Contacts, Deals, Rentals, TempLeads and OwnerRequests, render a stacked row list under sm (name + one line of key facts + Call/WhatsApp icon buttons as MyDay does at MyDay.tsx:131-132) and keep the table from sm up, mirroring the Pipeline split.
benefit: The three screens agents use between calls become readable on a phone without sideways dragging, and a number is tappable from the list.

title: DB Search tab bar hides Unit history, Area, Market behind a Tools menu
what: DbSearch.tsx:197-208 shows 4 tabs (Smart, Search, Phone, Agents); Market, Checks, Vastu, Portfolio sit in a hover-style dropdown behind a 'Tools' button (DbSearch.tsx:171-186) that closes on mousedown outside (line 75) — fine on desktop. On a phone the brand bar at DbSearch.tsx:121-131 has to fit logo + session timer (hidden under sm, line 166) + Tools + a green 'WhatsApp campaign' button + theme + Back to CRM + Exit, wrapped with flex-wrap (line 130) into two or three rows of 32px buttons above the tab bar. ds_unit and ds_area are not in any menu at all (DS_VIEWS line 26 vs TABS line 37 and MORE line 29); they are reachable only via a link from a result.
proposal: Under md, collapse the brand-bar actions into one overflow menu (theme, Back to CRM, Exit, Tools entries, WhatsApp campaign) so the bar is logo + timer + one menu button, and keep the 4-tab row as the only navigation. Add 'Unit history' to the Tools list so it is reachable without first running a search.
benefit: The DB Search bar fits one row on a phone and the search box is above the fold; the agent sees the query field first, not a wall of buttons.

title: Unused mobile target bar in TargetMeter
what: TargetMeter.tsx:25-37 implements a variant="bar" rendering ('md:hidden' strip for phones) but CrmApp.tsx:329 only ever mounts variant="sidebar", which is inside the md:flex aside. Agents on a phone never see their quarterly target; the 'bar' code is dead.
proposal: Either mount <TargetMeter variant="bar" /> under the mobile header in CrmApp (or at the top of MyDay for agents), or delete the bar variant.
benefit: The agent sees their quarter number on the device they actually carry, or the codebase loses 13 lines nobody runs.

title: Lead/contact side panel is a full-screen sheet with no Back gesture
what: shared.tsx:265-281 SidePanel is fixed inset-0 with w-full max-w-[560px]; on a phone it covers the whole screen, the only exits are an 8x8 X at shared.tsx:276 or Escape (shared.tsx:254-262). The Android hardware/gesture Back fires popstate, which CrmApp.tsx:213-218 handles by re-reading the hash — the panel stays open and the view may jump. The panel header's action row (LeadPanel.tsx:169-189: WhatsApp link, template <select>, tel link, mailto) wraps into three rows above the fold on 390px, pushing the Stage select (LeadPanel.tsx:198-210) below.
proposal: Push a history entry when a panel opens and close it on popstate (the hash listener at CrmApp.tsx:228 is already there). On phones, render the panel header actions as a single row of icon buttons (BTN_ICON) with WhatsApp and Call first and the template picker inside the WhatsApp action.
benefit: The Back gesture closes the lead instead of losing the agent's place, and Call/WhatsApp are the first thing on screen when a lead opens.

title: 'Lead / Contact / Temp lead' add links are 12px text taps
what: DsCardView.tsx:155-162 renders the three 'add to CRM' actions as inline text buttons at text-[12px] separated by '·', with Call and WhatsApp as h-7 (28px) chips at lines 150-151. These are the actions that turn a DB Search result into a lead — the core reason an agent searches — and on a phone they are the smallest targets on the card. DsOwnerPanel.tsx:97-98 uses 32px buttons for the same actions, so the two views disagree.
proposal: Use the same h-8 BTN sizing as DsOwnerPanel for Call/WhatsApp and turn the add trio into one 'Add to CRM' button that opens a three-option choice, under sm.
benefit: Saving a found owner as a lead from a phone becomes a sure tap instead of a fiddly one, and fewer wrong-option taps.

title: Everything sheet is a flat grid of 30 chips without search
what: CrmApp.tsx:499-509 lists every section and every view as 36px chips, including the 7-item admin group and 4 DB Search chips that each open a new tab (via setView → DS_VIEWS card at CrmApp.tsx:393-399, which is itself just another 'Open DB Search' button). Sign out is at the bottom (CrmApp.tsx:510) while the profile is only reachable via the avatar at CrmApp.tsx:361. The sheet has no 'current' highlight at section level and no recently-used ordering.
proposal: Order the sheet by use: top row Leads/People/Deals/Listings/Tasks, then Tools, then Admin collapsed by default for admin, with DB Search as one row that opens the search directly rather than the intermediate card. Add 'My profile' next to Sign out.
benefit: Two-tap destinations become predictable; agents stop scrolling the admin block they cannot use.

title: Pipeline filter bar and stats are desktop-first on phones
what: Pipeline.tsx:70-106 renders a search input (min-w-[220px]), two <select>s with !w-auto, Export, Auto-assign and Add leads in one flex-wrap row; on 390px this becomes 3-4 rows of controls before the first lead. The stats <dl> at Pipeline.tsx:61 is hidden under sm, so the agent loses the overdue count on the phone while keeping every control. The phone list's stage <select> (Pipeline.tsx:136-148) is correct, but each card has no Call/WhatsApp, unlike MyDay rows (MyDay.tsx:131-132).
proposal: Under sm, show only the search box and the Add button, with owner/source filters behind one 'Filter' toggle; show a one-line StatusLine with the overdue/new counts; add the Call and WhatsApp icon buttons to each phone card as MyDay already does.
benefit: The lead list starts above the fold on a phone, and an agent can ring a lead from the list without opening it.
